mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy amid inflation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is absent when Rank IC for combined signal falls below 0.03, or positive return rate drops below 55% in triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion (HOUST > 900 thousand units), strong residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), monetary tightening reduces corporate borrowing and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000 million dollars) indicates sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor and consumer spending regime
failure_condition: The combined signal fails when SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
